# NMU-CE & AIE

> Study platform for Computer Engineering (CE) and Artificial Intelligence
> Engineering (AIE) students: lectures and PDF materials, video explanations,
> interactive quizzes with a question bank, and a virtual lab.

The app is a client-rendered single-page application and requires JavaScript.
Main sections (all crawlable entry points, content loads after boot):

- [Home](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/): study hub and student profile.
- [Study Materials](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/materials): lectures and PDF files per level and semester.
- [Videos](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/videos): lecturer recordings and curated YouTube explanations.
- [Quizzes & Question Bank](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/quizzes): practice quizzes with answer explanations and timed exam mode.
- [Virtual Lab](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/laboratory): interactive electricity and circuits simulations.
- [YouTube Explanations](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/youtube): curated channels organized by subject.
- [Feedback](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/feedback): suggestions and contact form.

Machine-readable index: [sitemap.xml](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/sitemap.xml)
Crawl rules: [robots.txt](https://www.nmu-ce.giize.com/robots.txt)
